name: Round 3 wreck husk concepts (assets stretch)
why: The brief's stretch item: a wreck husk concept for the wreck a unit leaves when it dies (feel's wreck effects; the round-2 fires burn where kills happened). One shared husk that reads as 'a destroyed vehicle' from the RTS camera, scaled per unit, so no per-unit wreck art. Gated like every concept.
tail: Full object in frame, three-quarter view from slightly above, isolated on a plain dark grey studio background, no ground, no people, no text, no logos. Photorealistic, gritty, high detail, cinematic lighting, grounded real-world materials.

arena.label: Arena kit
arena.intro: What a vehicle leaves behind: one burned-out husk, scaled to the unit that died, smoldering where the kill happened. Pick one, or none.
arena.lead: Photorealistic concept art of a destroyed arena death-race {role}, Death Race meets Mad Max, after a battle at night.
arena.look: Blackened and scorched steel, burned-off paint with ghosts of yellow-black hazard stripes, glowing orange embers inside the torn metal, a thin rising smoke wisp, no working lights, dead neon tubes hanging loose.

role_notes.wreck: Left where a unit dies (feel's wreck effects). One model for every unit, scaled to its hull, so it must read as a generic armored war machine.

concepts.title: burned-out armored truck shell
concepts.subject: The gutted shell of a heavy armored truck with slab armor: the cab caved in, the turret ring empty and the turret thrown off, wheels burned down to the rims, armor plates peeled back and buckled.
concepts.notes: Reads clearly as 'that was a vehicle' from above; a long, truck-like footprint.

concepts.title: crushed scrap-heap hulk
concepts.subject: A low crushed hulk of a war machine flattened into a heap: a twisted chassis frame, a bent cannon barrel sticking out, tangled chains and spikes, a broken road wheel on its side.
concepts.notes: Lower and messier; fits any unit shape when scaled, but reads less as a specific vehicle.
